dialogue.content: 相談者役をさせて頂きます。どうぞよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: I'll be playing the role of the client. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: The pleasure is all mine. It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。よろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: 相談員です　こんにちは　始めに　年齢と性別を教えてください
dialogue.English: I'm the counselor. Hello. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 17歳　女性です
dialogue.English: I'm 17 years old and female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのような　ご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: クラスの人から嫌がらせをされています
dialogue.English: I'm being harassed by people in my class.

dialogue.content: 嫌がらせは嫌ですよね
dialogue.English: Being harassed must be awful.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 状況を詳しく聞きたいので　いくつか質問させて頂いてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to understand the situation in more detail, so may I ask you a few questions?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校にはちゃんと登校してますか？
dialogue.English: Are you managing to go to school regularly?

dialogue.content: はい、一応。
dialogue.English: Yes, for the most part.

dialogue.content: では学校での　嫌がらせの事を　言える範囲内でよいのでもう少し教えてくださいね
dialogue.English: Then, please tell me a little more about the harassment at school—only as much as you feel comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Okay...

dialogue.content: どの様な嫌がらせなんでしょう？
dialogue.English: What kind of harassment is it?

dialogue.content: 体育の授業前に体育館に行ったら、バスケットボールを投げつけられて、
dialogue.English: When I went to the gym before PE class, they threw a basketball at me, and...

dialogue.content: それは　ひどいですね　お辛かったでしょう？
dialogue.English: That's terrible. That must have been very upsetting for you.

dialogue.content: はい。あと、すれ違う時に舌打ちされたり、睨まれたりしています。
dialogue.English: Yes. Also, when we pass each other, they click their tongues at me and glare at me.

dialogue.content: 色々な嫌がらせを受けてしまうのは本当につらいでしょうし　悲しいですね
dialogue.English: It must be truly painful and sad to be subjected to all these different kinds of harassment.

dialogue.content: 最近は席替えで
dialogue.English: Recently, with the seat change—

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: その人たちと近い席になって
dialogue.English: ...and I ended up seated near those people.

dialogue.content: もう嫌です
dialogue.English: I just can't stand it anymore.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。嫌がらせをされてる人と近い席になりどうしてよいのか　わからない様子に感じますが　どうですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you're feeling lost about what to do now that you're sitting so close to the people harassing you. Is that right?

dialogue.content: 担任の先生には手紙を書いたり、職員室に行って伝えました。
dialogue.English: I wrote a letter to my homeroom teacher and went to the staff room to tell them.

dialogue.content: それで　先生は何か対応してくれましたか？
dialogue.English: And did the teacher do anything in response?

dialogue.content: 先生は、
dialogue.English: The teacher...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 席替えの事はみんな平等だから、あなただけ特別扱いをするわけにはいかないと言われました。
dialogue.English: They said seat assignments have to be fair to everyone, so they can’t give me special treatment.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。　あなたの意見は　聞いてもらえなかったんですねそれは　残念です
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel that your concerns weren't heard. That's really unfortunate.

dialogue.content: せっかく　勇気をだして　先生の所まで　いったのにね…悔しいですね
dialogue.English: Especially after you gathered up the courage to go to the teacher... That must be so frustrating.

dialogue.content: 誰も私の事を分かってくれないと思いました。
dialogue.English: I felt like no one understands me.

dialogue.content: どうして　わかってくれないとおもうのか　思い当たる所はありかすか？
dialogue.English: Is there any particular reason you feel they don't understand?

dialogue.content: よくわからないです
dialogue.English: I'm not really sure.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お友達とは普段はお話されてますか？
dialogue.English: Do you usually talk with your friends?

dialogue.content: まあ、普通に。
dialogue.English: Well, normally.

dialogue.content: お友達の関係の事を少し教えてくれますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a little about your friendships?

dialogue.content: 部活で話したりしてます
dialogue.English: We talk during club activities.

dialogue.content: お話は普通にしてるんですね
dialogue.English: So you talk with them normally.

dialogue.content: まあ、はい。
dialogue.English: Well, yes.

dialogue.content: では　どんな時に嫌がらせを　されるのですか？
dialogue.English: Then, when does the harassment happen?

dialogue.content: だから、授業の前とか、すれ違う時とか、さっき話しましたよね。
dialogue.English: Like I said—before class, or when we pass each other. I already mentioned that.

dialogue.content: はい　聞いてますね。部活の時は　話せるのに　部活以外で嫌がらせをされる理由でもあるんですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right, I was listening. Is there a reason why they harass you outside of club activities, even though you can talk during them?

dialogue.content: それはわからないです。
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 何で嫌がらせされている私が責められないといけないんですか？
dialogue.English: Why do I have to be blamed when I'm the one being harassed?

dialogue.content: 自分でも　わからないのは　もどかしいですね
dialogue.English: It must be frustrating not to know the reason yourself.

dialogue.content: 違います。あなたに話しているんです。
dialogue.English: No, that's not it. I'm talking to you.

dialogue.content: ええ　わかっています　何か勘違いをせてしまったのなら　ごめんなさいね
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. I apologize if I've caused a misunderstanding.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんに。
dialogue.English: I mean you, the counselor.

dialogue.content: 勘違いって、、私が悪いみたい。
dialogue.English: 'A misunderstanding'...? That makes it sound like it's my fault.

dialogue.content: 私の言い方がわるかったんですね　すみません
dialogue.English: I phrased that poorly. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: もういいです。大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Never mind. It's fine.

dialogue.content: せっかく　ご相談にいらっしゃったのですし少しでも　あなたの　お気持ちを理解したいので　もう少し　お話させてくださいね
dialogue.English: You came all this way to talk, and I want to understand how you're feeling, even just a little. Please, let's talk a bit more.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 友達から　嫌がらせされるのは　本当につらですね。先生にも聞き入れてもらえなくて…
dialogue.English: It's truly painful to be harassed by friends. And to have your teacher not listen to you, either...

dialogue.content: 誰も分かってくれなくて嫌です
dialogue.English: I hate that no one understands.

dialogue.content: この間、
dialogue.English: The other day,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 体育の先生にも手紙書いたんです
dialogue.English: I also wrote a letter to the PE teacher.

dialogue.content: 聴いてますよ
dialogue.English: I'm listening.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分のこと知ってほしくて
dialogue.English: I wanted them to know what was happening to me.

dialogue.content: わかってほしいよね
dialogue.English: You want to be understood, don't you.

dialogue.content: でも全然だめで、他の女子からも人気があるから難しいのかなと
dialogue.English: But it was no use. I wonder if it's difficult because they're popular with the other girls.

dialogue.content: 女子校なんです。通っているのが。
dialogue.English: I go to an all-girls school.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: この高校に入って全然いいことがなくて
dialogue.English: Nothing good has happened at all since I started this high school.

dialogue.content: 嫌になります
dialogue.English: I'm just sick of it.

dialogue.content: いいことないのは　お辛いですね
dialogue.English: It must be hard when nothing good is happening.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいかわからないです
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: 何をしても良いことがないのは　とても　すっきりしませんんものね
dialogue.English: It's very unsettling when it feels like nothing you do leads to anything good, isn't it.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうしたらよいか　について　すこしおしえてくださいね
dialogue.English: Could you elaborate a little on what you mean by 'what to do'?

dialogue.content: 教えてください、というのは？
dialogue.English: 'Tell me'... what do you mean?

dialogue.content: よくわからないです
dialogue.English: I don't really understand.

dialogue.content: 嫌がらせが　いや周りの人への恐怖感なのか体育の先生への事など　もう少し聞かせてください
dialogue.English: Please tell me a bit more—is it about the harassment itself, a fear of the people around you, or the issue with the PE teacher?

dialogue.content: 相談員さんが何が言いたいか分からないです。
dialogue.English: I don’t understand what you’re trying to say, counselor.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい　いや周りはいや　誤です
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, that was a typo in my previous message.

dialogue.content: 聞かせてください、はわかりますが、何をどう話したらいいか、よくわかりません。
dialogue.English: I understand you want me to tell you more, but I don't know what to say or how to say it.

dialogue.content: 嫌がらせを　されるから　不安などが　おありなのかなと思ったのですが　いかがでしょう？
dialogue.English: I was wondering if perhaps you're feeling anxious because of the harassment. Is that the case?

dialogue.content: 不安というか、、毎日うんざりしてます。いつ席替えがあるかもわからないし。
dialogue.English: It's not so much anxiety... I'm just fed up with it every day. I don't even know when the next seat change will be.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 父も母もあてにならないし
dialogue.English: I can’t count on my parents, either.

dialogue.content: 誰もあてにならない　わかってくれないのは寂しいですね
dialogue.English: It must be lonely to feel like you can't rely on anyone and no one understands you.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも　ここで私とお話されていますし少なくとも　私は　聞いてますし　わかってますから独りではないですよ。
dialogue.English: But you're here talking with me, and at the very least, I am listening and I do understand. So you're not alone.

dialogue.content: まあ、、
dialogue.English: Well...

dialogue.content: 話をいつでも聞きますから　誰もわかってくれないと思うときまた　来てくださいね
dialogue.English: I'm always here to listen, so please come back anytime you feel like nobody understands.

dialogue.content: もう終わりなんですか？
dialogue.English: So, is it over already?

dialogue.content: すくなくとも　ここでは　ひとりでは　ありませんから。
dialogue.English: At the very least, you’re not alone here.

dialogue.content: だからもう終わりなんですか？
dialogue.English: So, I'm asking, is it over?

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間はきましたが　今日は　どうでしたか？
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up. How was the session for you today?

dialogue.content: これってAIなんですか？
dialogue.English: Is this an AI?

dialogue.content: 違いますよ
dialogue.English: No, it's not.

dialogue.content: 今日は限られたお時間の中で　お話を聞かせてもらいましたが　お話が　煮詰まらない感じでしたのでまた　いつでも来てほしいと　思いましたよ。
dialogue.English: We spoke within our limited time today, and while it felt like our conversation didn't quite get to the heart of the matter, it made me hope that you would come back again anytime.

dialogue.content: 煮詰まらないって、私のせいですか？
dialogue.English: 'Didn't get to the heart of the matter'? Are you saying that's my fault?

dialogue.content: もういいです。
dialogue.English: Forget it.

dialogue.content: さようなら
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: また来てくださいね　では終了しますね
dialogue.English: Please come again. I'll end the session now.
